modules.module_title: Analyze the fabric design for weaving

pcs.pc_description: analyze the fabric parameters for weaving. i.e., Warp color, Weft Colour, Fabric structure, Extra weft design, warp count, weft count, ends per inch, picks per inch, number of multiple sheds required for inserting extra weft.
arrange required defect free warp yarn sheet and weft yarn package for Weaving.
arrange necessary number of Bamboo lease rods and beating rod and their positions as per the weave structure.
prepare the yarn hank for warping and ensure it is defect free.
prepare warp sheet as the per the required fabric specification. i.e., Length, Width, No of warp ends, color pattern and design to be woven.
tie up the shedding heddles to the heddle stick through the warp sheet to facilitate shed formation as per the fabric structure requirement.
mount the warp sheet in loop form over the loom rods at adequate tension for weaving.
arrange the lease and fix required number bamboo lease rods as per the extra weft design.
prepare the weft yarn for winding as per weft color requirement.
wind the weft yarn for base fabric on pirn or wooden stick manually or by winding machine.
prepare the extra weft yarn as per the design requirement.
adjust the backstrap or loom rods to get required warp tension for weaving
open the shed by lifting the heddle stick.
insert the Base weft/ extra figuring weft as per the design.
perform beat up using beating stick.
roll the loom rods anti clock wise to get the length of warp sheet forward for weaving.
maintain proper warp sheet tension.
lay the weft pick evenly parallel to the previous pick without slackness/loop to ensure the selvedges are clean
attend warp breakages and weft breakage as per design specification.
maintain even beat up force throughout the weaving.
maintain the quality as per customer specification.
cut the warp sheet carefully and do finishing. i.e., Tassling, trimming
join the woven fabrics as per specification
